messages:
inc-bot: ALERT — Stargazer (customer) private VPC: NLB target failures causing 5xx spike to inference endpoints. Pagerduty: PD-45678. Paging on-call.
maria: I'm on it, looking at CloudWatch. 5xx started ~16:13 UTC, spike across us-west-2. NLB stg-priv-nlb shows high 502/504 from target-group tg-stargazer-backend.
kevin: Oncall — grabbing context. Is this a Private pool only issue or affecting Dedicated/Hosted?
maria: Private pool only. Dedicated fallback exists but not auto-switched for 5xx. Customer pushed a security-policy change ~3h ago.
sam: Any sign of a recent rollout on the backend hosts? Could be OOM/crash.
alex: We have an option to flip routing to the dedicated-fallback pool for stargazer. That requires a routing map change in the control plane — emergency ok if customer agrees.
natalie: Quick mitigation idea: drain targets in the bad AZ (us-west-2b) from the NLB and restart model service on those hosts. If drift continues, we can fail traffic to fallback.
kevin: I'll run target health checks first. Maria, can you paste describe-target-health output?
maria: ```
$ aws elbv2 describe-target-health --target-group-arn arn:aws:...:tg/tg-stargazer-backend
{
  "TargetHealthDescriptions": [
    {"Target":{"Id":"i-0abcd1234"},"TargetHealth":{"State":"unhealthy","Description":"Connection refused"}},
    {"Target":{"Id":"i-0ef124567"},"TargetHealth":{"State":"healthy"}}
  ]
}
```
kevin: Deregistering unhealthy targets in us-west-2b now: `aws elbv2 deregister-targets --target-group-arn ... --targets Id=i-0abcd1234`
inc-bot: Deploybot: PR #556 proposed to route stargazer -> dedicated-fallback; not merged automatically.
mark: Also check security groups — customer tightened outbound rules earlier. `aws ec2 describe-security-groups --group-ids sg-0a1b2c`
maria: SG outbound to inference endpoint 443 is allowed. Looks like process crashed on i-0abcd1234 (OOM). Restarting model service: `sudo systemctl restart model-server` — restart in progress.
alex: If restarts fail, plan B: flip routing to hosted/dedicated fallback. We should notify CS before the flip.
cs-rep: Customer on call now. They saw the spike at 16:14 UTC and approved failover if issue not resolved in 2m.
kevin: Restarts succeeded. Healthchecks returning. `describe-target-health` now shows healthy for i-0abcd1234. Rolling traffic back.
maria: Logs show segfault in libtorch on those hosts — opening bug and tagging eng-ml.
inc-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE — Mitigation successful, traffic normalized. Severity downgraded to P2. Keep thread for postmortem.
mark: I'll kick off a postmortem runbook and include root cause notes (OOM/libtorch). Tagging @eng-ml and @eng-runtime. :white_check_mark:
cs-rep: Customer appreciates the quick response and will provide their deploy logs. We will keep monitoring for 30m and handoff if stable.
kevin: Oncall handoff scheduled in 15m if no regression. Closing active paging.
